_note: SAMPLE content for the prototype. Every item must be reviewed by a doctor or medical teacher before the jury demo.

HEART.text: Confirm the cath lab is free and staffed
ECG machine ready at the arrival bay
Defibrillator and monitor ready at the bay
Read allergies and current medicines from the health passport

STROKE.text: Note the symptom start time from the alert
Read blood-thinning medicines from the health passport
Blood glucose meter ready at the bay

DIABETIC.text: Blood glucose meter ready at the bay
Read diabetes medicines from the health passport

ASTHMA.text: Oxygen and nebuliser ready at the bay
Read allergies and inhaler medicines from the health passport
Confirm an ICU bed is available if needed
